notes: «قلت لعائشة ما قال قالت قال»: Asma asks Aisha, who answers with the Prophet's words; Aisha is a link in her own place (rule 5).
«عائشة» occurrence 1 («دخلت على عائشة») is the place Asma visits: not a link.
«قال هشام فلقد قالت لي فاطمة» restates the same transmission: not a new route. «شك هشام» and the scene's shouts are left out.
